answer: Agents trading telemetry from a reef sensor, raven tracker, or zephyr station can resist Sybil attacks via hardware TPM attestation. Each epoch, a verifier sends a nonce, and an agent returns a TPM quote plus an endorsement certificate chain proving its signing key is hardware-bound. Because endorsement keys are fused in silicon, attackers must buy and run separate chips per identity instead of cloning software, though vendor CA compromise can still enable forged software identities.
